title: Hate Chip
subtitle: Test your understanding of Hate Chip — the absence of organic malice in a true soul and the cybernetic implant infrastructure that enforces cognitive subjugation.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Human 2.0 is a technological lobotomy that captures divine soul energy for machine-controlled labor. Subcutaneous extremity implants were preparatory warm-ups. Guarding individual thought and refusing transhumanist bodily modifications keeps true human potential in uncorrupted soul architecture.

options.text: False

questions.question: What is the primary operational objective of the Human 2.0 initiative?

options.label: A
options.text: The primary operational objective is the conversion of sovereign humans into cyborgs powered by a true soul for obedient labor.
options.rationale: The primary operational objective of the Hate Chip control framework is the conversion of sovereign humans into cyborgs.

options.label: B
options.text: The primary operational objective is an evolutionary upgrade of human consciousness into higher densities through technological augmentation.
options.rationale: Human 2.0 is the technical application of cybernetic enslavement upon sovereign humans rather than an evolutionary upgrade or health restoration.

options.label: C
options.text: The primary operational objective is biological elimination of every incarnate human vessel through advanced subcutaneous bioweapon injections.
options.rationale: Biological elimination via bioweapon injections was designated for non-souled entities while every true soul was designated for conversion.

options.label: D
options.text: The primary operational objective is a clinical cure that replaces damaged brain tissue with synthetic machinery for neurological repair.
options.rationale: This system does not function as a legitimate clinical procedure or medical cure and operates as a coercive framework for total mental enslavement.

questions.hint: Focus on the architectural goal regarding free will and manual labor capability.

options.label: B

options.rationale: The lobotomized state reduces the entity to automated physical work rather than commercial management or digital operation.

options.label: D

options.rationale: The operational environment is industrial labor categorized through factories and mines rather than fields or space stations.

options.rationale: Controllers used incremental public warm-ups rather than immediate compulsory neural brain surgery.

options.rationale: Digital inserts are non-souled entities targeted for biological elimination rather than the conditioning mechanism.
